errors.text_span: Третият по големина, в червено, е „5–10%“ с 14.3%. Четвъртият, в зелено, е „15–20%“ с 19%
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly ranks the sectors by size. The third largest sector is the green one ('15–20%' with 19%), and the fourth largest is the red one ('5–10%' with 14.3%). The description has their ranks swapped.
